comparison: DMD (AB1071, n=3 technical/passage replicates of one line) vs healthy (AB1190, n=3 replicates of one line)
filter_rule: raw count >= 10 in at least 3 of 6 samples
limitation_design: Each group is a single immortalized cell line (healthy AB1190, DMD AB1071), so the three samples per group are replicates of one donor background rather than independent donors. Every differential-expression result from this design is confounded with cell-line identity. The analysis cannot attribute any difference to dystrophin deficiency as opposed to donor genotype, immortalization history, or passage. This is not n=6 independent samples.
limitation_scope: Transcript abundance is not pump activity and not calcium flux. This dataset cannot show that sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium clearance is impaired, that SERCA function is reduced, or that the clearance-based model is correct. Permitted conclusions concern transcript levels of the named genes in these two cell lines.
multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg over all tested genes (independent filtering disabled)
test: DESeq2 negative-binomial Wald test, design ~group, contrast DMD vs healthy
